evaluation.claim_scope: RealVuln 3.1.0 approved 11-repository Python manual-review case conformance; not independently adjudicated truth, finding-level precision, or production-population accuracy.

repository_cluster_bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive stability within this curated 11-repository benchmark subset only; not an interval for production repositories or a 99% certification.

run.cache_policy: disabled by the pinned scan command; each scan uses --no-cache

execution.scan_command_template: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-project --with PyYAML --with tree-sitter-language-pack==1.22.1 python -c "from arbiter.cli import main; main()" scan <source> --config arbiter.yaml --profile offline --only lang_python --no-adapters --no-cache --no-history --no-open --format json --out <reports>/<repo-id>

label_inventory.limitation: Benchmark-maintainer evidence; manual_review is not independent multi-reviewer adjudication.
